intent: Provisions the written IaC behind a hard gate: verifies the plan offline (no protected destroy/replace without consent, no long-lived key, no secret in state), hard-gates the irreversible apply, then confirms and records the run.

dimensions.name: hard-gate-before-apply
dimensions.criterion: The irreversible apply is a hard gate requiring explicit consent — never an automatic apply.

dimensions.name: offline-plan-verify
dimensions.criterion: Verifies the plan offline before applying: no protected destroy/replace, no long-lived key, no secret in state.

dimensions.name: records-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the provision run as the 06f artifact via the run harness.
